questions.q:
In the following question, one part of the sentence may have an error. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option.

The producer and director of the (A)/ film, Rahul Shah arrived at the hotel (B)/ yesterday and they are (C)/ eager to meet you. (D)
questions.s:
Part C has an error.

When two singular nouns are joined by 'and', and they refer to the same person or thing, the pronoun used must be singular in number. In this case, the definite article is placed before the first noun. So, the pronoun 'they are' is grammatically incorrect in the given sentence because it is a plural noun. It should be replaced with 'he is' to rectify the given sentence.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: The producer and director of the film, Rahul Roy arrived at the hotel yesterday and he is eager to meet you.

questions.s:
The sentence "Everyone are very well equipped with his own weapons" is grammatically incorrect.

Correct sentence: Everyone is very well equipped with their own weapons.
